{{Quote|How dare you barge into my private residence! Who do you think you are?|Palpatine, after General Grievous smashes through his window|<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 24">{{CW|24}}</ref>}}
'''Palpatine's apartment''' was a series of [[Senator/Legends|Senatorial]] apartments in the upper levels of [[500 Republica/Legends|500 Republica]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] used by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during his tenure as Senator of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and later as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Layout==
[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] apartment was an expansive suite of rooms perched in the upper levels of the [[500 Republica/Legends|500 Republica]] tower, a stepped building located in the old and prestigious [[Ambassadorial Sector]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]].<ref name="ITW" /> Although luxurious by common standards, Palpatine's apartment was still modest in comparison to the much larger penthouses in the top most levels of the building or the formidable palaces inhabited by certain other [[Senator/Legends|senators]].<ref name="TPMV">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The suite consisted of a reception room leading into the Royal Suite, from which Palpatine's personal quarters were located via a carefully guarded corridor. The primary reception room had access to exit [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]], and to a curving corridor leading to a soundproof ante-chamber to the main lounge area. This spacious room was located on the "corner" of one of 500 Republica's residential towers, and featured large [[Window/Legends|windows]] on the two exterior walls, with a balcony running along the side of one wall.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> That balcony was equipped with a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]], and it hosted secret meetings between [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious&mdash;Palpatine's [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] alter ego&mdash;and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="DMR">''[[Darth Maul's Revenge]]''</ref> In a busy, teeming [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] like [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], there were innumerable balconies and corridors, which allowed the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to hide in plain sight.<ref name="ITW" />

==Decor==
{{Quote|You certainly make no secret of your favourite color, Senator.''"<br />"''Scarlet figures prominently in the crest of my ancestral house.|[[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Staff Aide]] [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]] and Senator Palpatine|<ref name="SWDP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
[[File:PalpatinesApartment-TPM.png|thumb|left|250px|Queen Amidala discusses the blockade on their planet.]]
Every room of Palpatine's quarters, from floor to ceiling, was decorated various shades of [[Color/Legends|red]]&mdash;a color scheme that would later inspire the look of his [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancery office]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> and his private chamber onboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].<ref name="IWSWT">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> Even part of the furniture, including the armchairs of the reception area, was reddish-brown in hue.<ref name="TPM" /> During his extensive traveling prior to his tenure as [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] representative, Palpatine had gathered many foreign art objects, and those were displayed in his apartments. His unusual decorating taste revealed that the senator had distanced himself from his culture, having adopted a more cosmopolitan point of view.<ref name="TPMV" /> The various objects and statues picked up on his travels seemed to hold great personal value for him. It was often noted that he would enter into a near-meditative contemplation of the form and alien beauty of his collection, and seemed to draw strength from them.<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|32|COR 11-12|Coruscant &ndash; Palpatine's Apartments}}</ref>

He also displayed several items given to him by his peers in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Senator [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]] of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] gave him three large pearls from the [[Ocean/Legends|seas]] of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], held in the cup-like ends of polished, fossilized [[trumpet weed]]; Senator [[Baskol Yeesrim/Legends|Baskol Yeesrim]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] offered an ornate, ceremonial [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[wind drum]] from an ancient spiritual era; and [[Triffian/Legends|Triffian]] Senator [[Eelen Li]] bequeathed Palpatine with a near-prehistoric [[Unidentified Triffian carving|stone carving]] of one of her [[Triffian/Legends|species]].<ref name="FF" />

==History==
{{Quote|Captain. If you ''must'' escort me home, I'm leaving now.|Chancellor Palpatine, to [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]|<ref name="Friends and Enemies">{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}}</ref>}}
During his [[Time/Legends|time]] as a small-time politician, Palpatine maintained official quarters on his home planet of Naboo. He later relocated&mdash;with his collection of decorative items&mdash;to Coruscant upon being elected to serve as his homeworld's representative following the assassination of Senator [[Vidar Kim]] in [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]].<ref name="SWDP" /> During his tenure as senator, Palpatine rarely allowed strangers in his sanctum; only his most trusted confidants were normally admitted there.<ref name="TPMV" /> It was in his apartments that Palpatine discussed the broadening of Naboo's horizons with [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] prior to the latter's abdication in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], and discussed the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion of Naboo]] with his successor, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] [[32 BBY/Legends|later]].<ref name="SWDP" />

During the clandestine search for [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] Amidala in 32 BBY, Palpatine met with Darth Maul on the balcony of his quarters at night, with the [[Hawk-bat/Legends|hawk-bats]] shrieking overhead.<ref name="DMR" /> Later meetings with his Sith apprentices would take place elsewhere, including a [[LiMerge Power/Legends|LiMerge Power]] building in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]].<ref name="AoC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

Palpatine retained his apartment suite upon becoming [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], though he was afforded an office suite in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] that boasted its own private chamber in which Palpatine could rest after particularly tiring days. It was from his 500 Republica apartment that [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] attempted to kidnap Palpatine during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]],<ref name="CW23">{{CW|23}}</ref><ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> though the Chancellor was rescued, briefly, by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]]. During this struggle, Grievous smashed the window of Palpatine's apartment,<ref name="CW23" /> and though it was presumably fixed, it is not known whether Palpatine retained his quarters upon becoming [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:George_and_Ian.jpg|thumb|[[George Lucas]] standing with [[Ian McDiarmid]] in the quarters of Palpatine]]
Palpatine's chambers appeared in the [[1999]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. They were made red so as to reminisce the colors of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guards]], who were first seen in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] in [[1983]].<ref name="TPMIG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> That particular set, which was built on one of the soundstages of [[Leavesden Studios]],<ref name="SWold">{{SWArchive|url=episode-i/fun/snapshot/1999/07/snapshot19990712.html|series=Episode I Snapshot|text=George Lucas stands with Ian McDiarmid}}</ref> was only completed the day before the shoot. The outsides of the apartment's windows were entirely covered with blue screens, which were replaced by a panoramic view of Galactic City.<ref name="TPMIG" />
